workshop: A reduced replica in London, long thought his own, was shown by analysis to be painted after his death [NG-SP].

layering_and_impasto: Three successive compositions on one canvas: a woman's portrait, then the artist with his companion, then the present picture, half effacing the second ten years later [CRMF; REICHE15]. Eight or more paint layers [REICHE16]. Painted 1844 and reworked ten years later [OBJ].
pigments_and_medium: MA-XRF maps of Hg, Cu, As, Fe, Zn, Cr, Ba, Pb and Ca; a palette was established for each composition, but the pigments were not read (abstract only) [REICHE16].

layering_and_impasto: Preparatory drawing on paper; figures sketched in light or dark brown line; ébauche with a little lead white; landscape blocked in early; heads left in reserve; one figure moved 28 cm [ORS-ENT].
pigments_and_medium: X-ray fluorescence: traditional pigments with some then-recent ones, not named [ORS-ENT].
condition_and_changes: Active cracks, lifting, adhesion loss; deformed 1884 stretcher; yellowed varnishes; restoration from 2025 [ORS-ENT].

ground: Thick warm gray ground (lead white, ivory black, yellow earth, vermilion, barium sulfate) under a thin dark reddish-brown layer (red earth, vermilion, probably charcoal) [NG5983].
layering_and_impasto: Over an earlier composition seen in the X-radiograph (fruit, a knife); colorful background layers with intermediate varnishes; red lake glaze over opaque orange-red; wet-in-wet greens [NG5983].
pigments_and_medium: Vermilion, cadmium yellow with zinc, lead white, yellow and red earths, Indian yellow, red lake, viridian, ivory black, French ultramarine; heat-bodied linseed oil and possibly walnut [NG5983].
condition_and_changes: Wax-lined 1969; paint thin except in the lights (1951 report); moderately discolored varnish [NG5983].
